meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤分析代码、构建依赖图、评估测试覆盖、生成计划，然后逐步重构并每步验证测试通过。
howto.when: 当你提到“refactor”、“重构”、“清理”、“简化”等关键词，或要求对文件、模块、项目进行重构时触发。

say.text: 重构所有使用已弃用 API 的函数
say.note: Claude 会查找相关代码并逐步替换。

say.text: 把验证逻辑提取到单独模块
say.note: Claude 会规划并执行提取操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze code, build dependency maps, assess test coverage, generate a plan, then refactor step-by-step with verification after each step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "refactor", "cleanup", "simplify", or request to refactor a file, module, or project.

say_en.text: Refactor the AuthService class in src/auth/handler.ts
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and refactor safely.

say_en.text: Refactor all functions using deprecated API
say_en.note: Claude will find and replace them step by step.

say_en.text: Extract validation logic into a separate module
say_en.note: Claude will plan and execute the extraction.
